periods.time: Before and during the opening of the Vermillion-Quedland crisis
periods.label: 法米利昂代表与卡尔迪亚战场之眼
periods.affiliation: Hagun Academy; Vermillion side by trial and promise

status.current: survives Or-Gaule's ambush and the Caldia battle opening; continues supporting Vermillion despite depleted magic
status.condition: healed by Alice Ascaride's Unbreakable after severe wounds; later badly injured after luring B.B. away from troops

relationships.stella-vermillion: Lover and fiancee candidate; fights to be accepted by her family and to protect her homeland.
relationships.sirius-vermillion: Future father-in-law who tests him repeatedly and finally treats the war as Ikki's proof of family membership.
relationships.astrea-vermillion: Future mother-in-law who supports him and recognizes his sincerity.
relationships.lunaeyes-vermillion: Ally who asks him to train Vermillion fighters and accompany her to Quedland.
relationships.milialia-regi: Sniper partner during the Caldia operation; she marks targets that Ikki identifies.
relationships.alice-ascaride: Saves him from Or-Gaule, heals him with Unbreakable, and later shields him from B.B.

periods.summary: Ikki endures Sirius Vermillion's comic but serious acceptance tests, defeating him instantly in simulated combat, arm wrestling, and a marathon errand. He accepts Lunaeyes' request to train Timid and Milialia, then visits Quedland with Stella and Lunaeyes. During Or-Gaule's ambush, Ikki alone reacts fast enough to intercept Killing Opera with Ittou Rasetsu, saving the crowd at the cost of massive wounds and exhaustion. After Alice Ascaride evacuates and heals him, Ikki proposes the Caldia plan: he will act as Vermillion's aerial eyes, read the puppet-command wave patterns from a helicopter, and have Milialia mark relay nodes. He performs this role successfully until B.B. destroys the helicopter. Despite no magic and broken bones, Ikki blinds B.B. and deliberately lures the giant away from unconscious soldiers, nearly dying before Alice arrives.

key_events.summary: Defeats Sirius in successive tests while showing patience toward Sirius' fatherly jealousy.
Blocks Or-Gaule's mass-murder strike with Ittou Rasetsu and is gravely injured.
Identifies Or-Gaule's relay nodes from the air so Vermillion can free Quedland soldiers without killing them.
Lures B.B. away from the central avenue after the giant destroys the helicopter.

abilities: Ittou Shura physiology and focus control
